channel.title: Ab-Testing on Nikita Podlozhniy
channel.description: Recent content in Ab-Testing on Nikita Podlozhniy

item.title: Linearization: Turning Ratio Metrics into Per-User Metrics
item.description: A simple algebraic transformation that converts ratio metrics into independent per-user values, making T-tests and sensitivity techniques directly applicable

item.title: CUPED: Reducing Metric Variance with Pre-Experiment Data
item.description: How CUPED uses pre-experiment covariates to cut metric variance and boost AB test sensitivity — with a rigorous proof of what works and what silently breaks

item.title: Superiority vs Non-Inferiority Trials in AB Testing
item.description: Not every experiment needs to show improvement — sometimes proving you haven’t made things worse is enough. A practical guide to non-inferiority trial design.

item.title: Salts and Layers: Running Multiple AB Tests Simultaneously
item.description: How MD5-based traffic splitting with salts and a layer system lets you run dozens of orthogonal experiments without conflicts

item.title: Bucketing: Variance Reduction and Faster AB Tests
item.description: How aggregating observations into buckets normalises skewed metrics, reduces variance, and cuts computation — with a probability proof for choosing the right bucket count

item.title: Bootstrap Methods for AB Testing
item.description: Classical and Poisson bootstrap as non-parametric tools for normalizing skewed metrics and enabling valid T-tests on small samples

item.title: Delta Method for Ratio Metrics in AB Testing
item.description: Correct variance estimation for ratio metrics using the Delta Method — and why naive approaches quietly break your confidence intervals

item.title: Bayesian A/B Test is NOT immune to peeking
item.description: Practical guide: PyMC examples, hierarchical models, loss functions, HDI, and safe stopping rules
